0x05: Location field points to the public part of the OEM/IBV BIOS Signing Key Token or BIOS Signing Sub-CA Key Token when OEM uses a BIOS Signing Sub-CA key hierarchy.
0x06: Location filed points to the public part of the OEM/IBV BIOS Signing Key Token when OEM uses a BIOS Signing Sub-CA key hierarchy otherwise left as reserved
0x07: BIOS RTM volume Signature using OEM private key
0x68: Location field points to the backup copy of APCB data
0x69: Location field pointing to the interpreter binary that displays the video image
0x6A: Location field pointing to the MP2 FW configuration file
0x6B: Location field pointing to Main memory, which is shared with x86 from PSP FW (BIOS/Coreboot)
0x6C: MPM specific Configurations which will be used by AMF
0x6D: Location field points to BIOS variable flash NV store
0x6E: Deployment of various IP Debug Unit (DBGU) and Debug State Machine (DSM) setups.
0x6F: The OEM logo image used by BIOS directory type 0x69.
0x75: FMTC signed by customer Key and installed by customer to be used only within secure manufacturing
0x76: Public key delivered securely by customer to AMD, and signed/certified by AMD
0x78: Optional Public key delivered securely by customer to AMD, and signed/certified by AMD
0x79: FMTC with ALL tokens personalized to be valid for, and restricted to, specific SOC(s)
0x7A: Secure Logging of End-User Trouble History (SLEUTH). Used to log issues during BLs2 and keep the records in SPI flash.
0x7B: MPRAS applet is a user space module which runs on MPRAS IP to enable the RAS use cases.
0x7C: Sweet Spot Profile is to provide a 1-click solution to enable platform optimized memory overclocking profiles for specific DIMMs like a software EXPO Profile.
0xC0: BL31 FW is ARM Trusted Firmware. BL32 FW is ARM SPMC(Halfnium) + Secure Partitions.
